    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">15天学会AI应用开发（十五）使用LangChain封装AI执行链</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<span data-cke-copybin-start="1"><span data-cke-copybin-start="1">​</span></span>上一篇文章末尾给出了LangChain的简单调用例子，当然LangChain还支持更丰富的功能设置，接下来就介绍如何使用LangChain封装AI执行链，以实现更复杂的功能调用。
<h1>一、构造大模型实例</h1>
<p>在构造大模型实例之前，要先添加下面的导包语句，表示引入LangChain的大模型工具OllamaLLM：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="14" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22from%20langchain_ollama%20import%20OllamaLLM%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">from langchain_ollama import OllamaLLM</code></pre>
</div>
<p>在OllamaLLM的构造方法中，model参数是必填的，要指定当前引用的大模型名称，如下：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="13" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22%23%20%E8%BF%9E%E6%8E%A5%E6%9C%AC%E5%9C%B0%E7%A6%BB%E7%BA%BF%E5%A4%A7%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%EF%BC%88Ollama%EF%BC%89%5Cnllm%20%3D%20OllamaLLM(model%3D%5C%22qwen2%3A1.5b%5C%22)%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs"># 连接本地离线大模型（Ollama）
llm = OllamaLLM(model="qwen2:1.5b")</code></pre>
</div>
<p>除了model参数以外，OllamaLLM还提供了多个可选参数，帮助开发者定制个性化的大模型调用需求。其中常用的核心参数说明如下：<br>
model: 模型名称，比如："qwen:7b"、"llama3"、"deepseek-r1"等等。<br>
base_url: 服务地址，默认的本地地址为"http://localhost:11434"。<br>
temperature: 模型温度，即随机性。取值范围0~1，默认0.8；值越低则越严谨越确定，值越高越跳跃越创意。<br>
num_ctx: 上下文Token的最大数量，默认2048。值越大则能记忆越长的对话内容。<br>
num_predict: 回答内容Token的最大数量，默认128。值为-1表示不限制输出长度，值为-2表示填满上下文（跟上下文的Token数一致）。<br>
keep_alive: 模型常驻内存的时长（频繁调用必开），默认"5m"表示5分钟。值为"-1"表示永久常驻，值为"0"表示用完即关。<br>
validate_model_on_init: 初始化时是否校验模型存在与否，默认True表示启动程序时检查模型是否存在。</p>
<p>比如下面代码构造了一个定制各种参数的大模型实例：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="12" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22llm%20%3D%20OllamaLLM(%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20model%3D%5C%22qwen2%3A1.5b%5C%22%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20base_url%3D%5C%22http%3A%2F%2Flocalhost%3A11434%5C%22%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20temperature%3D0.7%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20num_ctx%3D4096%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20num_predict%3D1024%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20keep_alive%3D%5C%22-1%5C%22%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20validate_model_on_init%3DTrue%5Cn)%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">llm = OllamaLLM(
&nbsp; &nbsp; model="qwen2:1.5b",
&nbsp; &nbsp; base_url="http://localhost:11434",
&nbsp; &nbsp; temperature=0.7,
&nbsp; &nbsp; num_ctx=4096,
&nbsp; &nbsp; num_predict=1024,
&nbsp; &nbsp; keep_alive="-1",
&nbsp; &nbsp; validate_model_on_init=True
)</code></pre>
</div>
<h1>二、构建提示词模板</h1>
<p>在构建提示词模板之前，要先添加下面的导包语句，表示引入LangChain的提示模板工具PromptTemplate：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="11" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22from%20langchain_core.prompts%20import%20PromptTemplate%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">from langchain_core.prompts import PromptTemplate</code></pre>
</div>
<p>PromptTemplate的from_template方法主要输入字符串形式的模板参数，字符串的开头为提示词内容，末尾为“{input}”表示给输入的问题文字占个位子。</p>
<p>比如下面代码构建了一个提示词模板：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="10" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22prompt%20%3D%20PromptTemplate.from_template(%5C%22%5C%22%5C%22%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%E4%BD%A0%E6%98%AF%E4%B8%93%E4%B8%9A%E5%8A%A9%E6%89%8B%EF%BC%8C%E8%AF%B7%E7%AE%80%E6%B4%81%E5%9B%9E%E7%AD%94%EF%BC%9A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%7Binput%7D%5Cn%5C%22%5C%22%5C%22)%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">prompt = PromptTemplate.from_template("""
&nbsp; &nbsp; 你是专业助手，请简洁回答：
&nbsp; &nbsp; {input}
""")</code></pre>
</div>
<p>可见上面模板的提示词内容为“你是专业助手，请简洁回答：”，这便告诉大模型回答时要简明扼要，不要啰哩叭嗦。同时后面的“{input}”提前在模板中占个位置，后续将把用户输入的问题替换掉这个占位符。</p>
<h1>三、组装 AI 执行链</h1>
<p>为什么LangChain一定要组装执行链呢？想想看，按照程序设计的顺序控制流程，每次接口调用都经历了三个步骤：封装请求内容→执行接口调用→解析应答内容，如同下面的顺序调用代码：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="9" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22%23%20%E6%97%A0%E9%93%BE%20%E2%86%92%20%E6%89%8B%E5%86%99%E6%AF%8F%E4%B8%80%E6%AD%A5%EF%BC%8C%E5%B7%A8%E7%B9%81%E7%90%90%EF%BC%81%5Cnprompt_text%20%3D%20prompt.format(input%3D%5C%22%E4%BD%A0%E7%9A%84%E9%97%AE%E9%A2%98%5C%22)%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%23%201%20%E6%89%8B%E5%8A%A8%E6%8B%BC%E6%A8%A1%E6%9D%BF%5Cnresponse%20%3D%20llm.invoke(prompt_text)%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%202%20%E6%89%8B%E5%8A%A8%E8%B0%83%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%5Cnresult%20%3D%20parser.parse(response)%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%23%203%20%E6%89%8B%E5%8A%A8%E8%A7%A3%E6%9E%90%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs"># 无链 → 手写每一步，巨繁琐！
prompt_text = prompt.format(input="你的问题") &nbsp; &nbsp;# 1 手动拼模板
response = llm.invoke(prompt_text) &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; # 2 手动调模型
result = parser.parse(response) &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;# 3 手动解析</code></pre>
</div>
<p>可见这个接口调用流程被分解成了三行代码，有点繁琐。虽然上一行代码的输出参数就是下一行代码的输入参数，但也不得不分成三个语句依次调用。</p>
<p>于是LangChain引入了执行链的概念，把“构建提示词、调用模型、记忆（可选）、检索（可选）、解析应答”等操作按顺序串成一条自动流水线，只要一次性启动组装好的执行链，LangChain就自动跑完全流程，无需拆成多条语句来调用。</p>
<p>在组装执行链之前，要先添加下面的导包语句，表示引入LangChain的执行链工具RunnableSequence，以及默认的应答内容解析器StrOutputParser：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="8" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22from%20langchain_core.runnables%20import%20RunnableSequence%5Cnfrom%20langchain_core.output_parsers%20import%20StrOutputParser%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">from langchain_core.runnables import RunnableSequence
from langchain_core.output_parsers import StrOutputParser</code></pre>
</div>
<p>然后编写下面代码串起“构建提示词、调用模型、解析应答”这三个操作：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="7" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22chain%20%3D%20RunnableSequence(%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20prompt%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%7C%20llm%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%7C%20StrOutputParser()%5Cn)%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">chain = RunnableSequence(
&nbsp; &nbsp; prompt
&nbsp; &nbsp; | llm
&nbsp; &nbsp; | StrOutputParser()
)</code></pre>
</div>
<p>为了方便起见，可省略掉构造方法的工具名称RunnableSequence，简化代码如下：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="6" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22chain%20%3D%20(%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20prompt%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%7C%20llm%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%7C%20StrOutputParser()%5Cn)%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">chain = (
&nbsp; &nbsp; prompt
&nbsp; &nbsp; | llm
&nbsp; &nbsp; | StrOutputParser()
)</code></pre>
</div>
<p>还能进一步省略掉外围的圆括号，变成如下的一行代码：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="5" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22chain%20%3D%20prompt%20%7C%20llm%20%7C%20StrOutputParser()%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">chain = prompt | llm | StrOutputParser()</code></pre>
</div>
<p>这下清爽多了，完全去掉了组装过程中的各种方法调用及其输入输出参数，只留下各环节用到的实例名称，极大地简化了代码篇幅。</p>
<h1>四、通过执行链调用离线大模型</h1>
<p>接下来结合构造大模型实例、构建提示词模板、组装 AI 执行链等三个步骤，通过执行链调用实现离线大模型的快速问答功能。</p>
<p>在编写Python代码前，要先在命令行执行下面的pip安装命令：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="4" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22pip%20install%20langchain%20langchain-core%20langchain-ollama%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">pip install langchain langchain-core langchain-ollama</code></pre>
</div>
<p>接着在命令行窗口执行下面命令，以便启动Ollama并加载离线大模型：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="3" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22ollama%20serve%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">ollama serve</code></pre>
</div>
<p>然后编写下面的Python聊天测试代码，由用户在控制台输入问题来实现聊天交互：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="2" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22from%20langchain_core.prompts%20import%20PromptTemplate%5Cnfrom%20langchain_core.output_parsers%20import%20StrOutputParser%5Cnfrom%20langchain_ollama%20import%20OllamaLLM%5Cn%5Cndef%20main()%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%201.%20%E8%BF%9E%E6%8E%A5%E6%9C%AC%E5%9C%B0Ollama%E7%A6%BB%E7%BA%BF%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%EF%BC%8C%E6%9B%BF%E6%8D%A2%E6%88%90%E4%BD%A0%E6%9C%AC%E5%9C%B0%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E5%90%8D%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20llm%20%3D%20OllamaLLM(%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20model%3D%5C%22qwen2%3A1.5b%5C%22%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20base_url%3D%5C%22http%3A%2F%2F127.0.0.1%3A11434%5C%22%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20temperature%3D0.7%20%C2%A0%23%20%E9%9A%8F%E6%9C%BA%E6%80%A7%200%E4%B8%A5%E8%B0%A8~1%E5%88%9B%E6%84%8F%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20)%5Cn%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%202.%20%E6%9E%84%E5%BB%BA%E5%AF%B9%E8%AF%9D%E6%A8%A1%E6%9D%BF%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20prompt%20%3D%20PromptTemplate.from_template(%5C%22%5C%22%5C%22%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%E4%BD%A0%E6%98%AF%E4%B8%93%E4%B8%9A%E5%8A%A9%E6%89%8B%EF%BC%8C%E8%AF%B7%E7%AE%80%E6%B4%81%E5%9B%9E%E7%AD%94%EF%BC%9A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%7Binput%7D%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%5C%22%5C%22%5C%22)%5Cn%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%203.%20%E7%BB%84%E8%A3%85%E6%89%A7%E8%A1%8C%E9%93%BE%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20chain%20%3D%20prompt%20%7C%20llm%20%7C%20StrOutputParser()%5Cn%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%204.%20%E5%BE%AA%E7%8E%AF%E9%97%AE%E7%AD%94%E8%81%8A%E5%A4%A9%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20print(%5C%22%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%20%E7%A6%BB%E7%BA%BFAI%E8%81%8A%E5%A4%A9%E5%8A%A9%E6%89%8B%EF%BC%88%E8%BE%93%E5%85%A5exit%E9%80%80%E5%87%BA%EF%BC%89%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%5C%22)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20while%20True%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20user_text%20%3D%20input(%5C%22%E8%AF%B7%E8%BE%93%E5%85%A5%E9%97%AE%E9%A2%98%EF%BC%9A%5C%22)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20if%20user_text.lower()%20in%20%5B%5C%22exit%5C%22%2C%20%5C%22quit%5C%22%2C%20%5C%22%E9%80%80%E5%87%BA%5C%22%5D%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20print(%5C%22%E5%AF%B9%E8%AF%9D%E7%BB%93%E6%9D%9F%5C%22)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20break%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20print(%5C%22AI%E6%80%9D%E8%80%83%E4%B8%AD...%5C%22)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20response%20%3D%20chain.invoke(user_text)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20print(f%5C%22AI%E5%9B%9E%E5%A4%8D%EF%BC%9A%7Bresponse%7D%5C%5Cn%5C%22)%5Cn%5Cnif%20__name__%20%3D%3D%20%5C%22__main__%5C%22%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20main()%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">from langchain_core.prompts import PromptTemplate
from langchain_core.output_parsers import StrOutputParser
from langchain_ollama import OllamaLLM

def main():
&nbsp; &nbsp; # 1. 连接本地Ollama离线模型，替换成你本地模型名
&nbsp; &nbsp; llm = OllamaLLM(
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; model="qwen2:1.5b",
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; base_url="http://127.0.0.1:11434",
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; temperature=0.7 &nbsp;# 随机性 0严谨~1创意
&nbsp; &nbsp; )

&nbsp; &nbsp; # 2. 构建对话模板
&nbsp; &nbsp; prompt = PromptTemplate.from_template("""
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 你是专业助手，请简洁回答：
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {input}
&nbsp; &nbsp; """)

&nbsp; &nbsp; # 3. 组装执行链
&nbsp; &nbsp; chain = prompt | llm | StrOutputParser()

&nbsp; &nbsp; # 4. 循环问答聊天
&nbsp; &nbsp; print("===== 离线AI聊天助手（输入exit退出）=====")
&nbsp; &nbsp; while True:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; user_text = input("请输入问题：")
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; if user_text.lower() in ["exit", "quit", "退出"]:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; print("对话结束")
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; break
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; print("AI思考中...")
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; response = chain.invoke(user_text)
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; print(f"AI回复：{response}\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
&nbsp; &nbsp; main()</code></pre>
</div>
<p>运行上面的Python代码，根据提示输入问题内容“LangChain是什么？”，输出日志结果如下：</p>

<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%20%E7%A6%BB%E7%BA%BFAI%E8%81%8A%E5%A4%A9%E5%8A%A9%E6%89%8B%EF%BC%88%E8%BE%93%E5%85%A5exit%E9%80%80%E5%87%BA%EF%BC%89%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%5Cn%E8%AF%B7%E8%BE%93%E5%85%A5%E9%97%AE%E9%A2%98%EF%BC%9ALangChain%E6%98%AF%E4%BB%80%E4%B9%88%EF%BC%9F%5CnAI%E6%80%9D%E8%80%83%E4%B8%AD...%5CnAI%E5%9B%9E%E5%A4%8D%EF%BC%9ALangchain%20%E6%98%AF%E4%B8%80%E4%B8%AA%E5%9F%BA%E4%BA%8E%20PyTorch%20%E7%9A%84%E5%BC%80%E6%BA%90%E8%AF%AD%E8%A8%80%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E6%8E%A8%E7%90%86%E6%A1%86%E6%9E%B6%EF%BC%8C%E7%94%A8%E4%BA%8E%E6%9E%84%E5%BB%BA%E5%92%8C%E8%AE%AD%E7%BB%83%E5%A4%A7%E5%9E%8B%E7%9A%84%E9%A2%84%E8%AE%AD%E7%BB%83%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E3%80%82%E5%AE%83%E6%8F%90%E4%BE%9B%E4%BA%86%E4%B8%80%E4%B8%AA%E7%AE%80%E5%8D%95%E7%9A%84%20API%20%E6%9D%A5%E5%A4%84%E7%90%86%E8%BE%93%E5%85%A5%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE%EF%BC%8C%E7%84%B6%E5%90%8E%E8%BF%94%E5%9B%9E%E6%96%87%E6%9C%AC%E6%88%96%E4%BB%A3%E7%A0%81%E4%BD%9C%E4%B8%BA%E8%BE%93%E5%87%BA%E3%80%82%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">===== 离线AI聊天助手（输入exit退出）=====
请输入问题：LangChain是什么？
AI思考中...
AI回复：Langchain 是一个基于 PyTorch 的开源语言模型推理框架，用于构建和训练大型的预训练模型。它提供了一个简单的 API 来处理输入数据，然后返回文本或代码作为输出。</code></pre>
</div>
